d:
An amazing animation featuring my Tier 1 girls in a full-blown diorama of an apartment turned total harem playground! Packing every corner with my favorite girls strutting around in skimpy lingerie (or less), turning the whole place into a nonstop feast for the eyes. O course I couldn't let the fun stop there so in the bedroom we can see a steamy threesome going full throttle on the bed. I love how every detail screams indulgent fantasy overload, from the clutter of nerdy stuff to the girls scattered everywhere just waiting (or not waiting) their turn—pure commemorative perfection for hitting animation #10!
